hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If you can safely reach the safehouse after waiting t minutes, you can also reach it after waiting any time less than t.

hints.title: Fire Spread Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the earliest arrival time of fire at every cell in the grid using multi-source breadth traversal.

hints.title: Simulating Escape with Fire Arrival
hints.text: For a fixed wait time, simulate movement. A cell (r, c) is valid at person arrival time if person reaches it strictly before fire, except at the safehouse where simultaneous arrival is allowed.

hints.title: Binary Search on Wait Time Implementation

complexity.notes: Fire times are computed once in O(m * n). BFS check runs in O(m * n) during binary search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search on wait time from 0 to 10^9 times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) distance matrix caches fire propagation times.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate spots safehouse boundary exception where simultaneous arrival with fire is permitted.
